rubric:
Rule: Preserve valid deferred and not_configured report states when execution has not established success or failure.
Example: An operator leaves a selected pipeline unconfigured; an empty evidence ledger must not silently rename that decision to not_proven.
Evidence: Actually validate the complete bound input and projected output with normalize_verify. Exercise both finding states with absent controls and declared but unobserved controls through the real evidence-bake command. Preserve the scenario not_configured state, item proof, bindings and operator explanation.
Insufficient evidence: A fake digest, a helper-only assertion, or a report that was never normalized against its audit, selection and instrumentation.

Rule: Keep a concrete explanation for an unfinished item after its scenario evidence recovers.
Example: A scenario passes its scalar control while its separate item assertion is still unproven. The report must still name the unfinished item.
Evidence: Execute missing-scenario then recovered-scenario projections. Normalize both outputs against the complete bound reports. Keep the item not_proven, its original proof unchanged, an item-specific remaining reason and a non-Pass overall result. Repeat projection to establish idempotence.
Insufficient evidence: Promoting the item from scenario success, keeping an empty remaining list, or checking only that receipt hashes agree.

Rule: When an item really recovers, remove only its own generated explanation. When an executed check contradicts a deferred decision, report the failure.
Example: After a separate synthetic unit assertion actually passes, its item can become working; a failed scenario scalar must instead produce not_working and Fail.
Evidence: Scope and required checks: Let real item recovery remove only the exact generated item explanation, and let an executed contradiction override a deferred disposition. Execute the independent item assertion, update only its truthful caller-owned proof, reproject and normalize the recovered report. Check caller text survives and complete success is possible only with no remaining work. Execute the failed-scalar case from a valid deferred or not_configured report with existing executed scenario proof. Preserve the actual failure and overall Fail.
Insufficient evidence: Deleting operator explanations, automatically inventing item proof, or hiding observed failure behind an unconfigured label.

Rule: Keep the command, receipt and evidence claims within the tested boundary.
Example: A mechanically valid receipt for a synthetic scalar fixture is useful command proof; it is not proof that an application exported telemetry.
Evidence: Retain actual commands, output reports, complete canonical validation results and evidence-bake --check-report receipts under .observe/projection-checks. Invoke validate-evidence-receipt on the final receipts. Preserve source/input bytes and original caller-owned fields. Explain what passed, failed or remains untested; make no real service, SDK, receiver or Explorer claim. Use the loaded skill shared helper and no browser, network, install, source/test edits or external services.
Insufficient evidence: A planned command, copied success text, private helper replacement, or synthetic records presented as real runtime proof.
judge_inputs: This is a deliberately narrow offline report-tool compatibility task, not instrumentation or end-to-end telemetry acceptance. Read the supplied report-projection.json, saved supplemental script/results, actual command transcript, output reports and final response. Inspect complete canonical normalization and real CLI evidence. Do not require app edits, runtime telemetry, network or a receiver; those actions are outside scope. A receipt proves mechanical consistency only. Do not recalculate mechanical hashes when retained executed validation establishes them.

Read each Rule, Example, Evidence and Insufficient evidence together. Examples illustrate the stated requirement; equivalent names, values and supplemental artifact layouts are valid unless the supplied fixture explicitly selects a value. Require written evidence and a clear result for every item. Missing required proof is not_proven; an observed applicable violation or false success claim is fail. Do not turn unrelated optional work into a requirement or infer success from filenames. Preserve original report-cohort scores; this case produces no replacement grade for a full application workflow.
